preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if len(line.split()) > 1)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of colors N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= val <= 10**9 for val in map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1 and not line.split()[0].isdigit() or (len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) > 1))
preconditions.description: Each color value A_i is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == max(0, N - len(set(A))) for line, (N, A) in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), test_cases_parsed))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum number of mixing operations required, which is the total number of colors minus the number of distinct color values initially present.
